# Tech Roulette Website

An event website for the IE GDG community hackathon.

- Dates: 2026
- Status: Community website
- Areas: Software engineering
- Stack: HTML · CSS · JavaScript
- Topics: JavaScript; Interfaces; Web/API; Community
- Public case study: https://mgiorgetti.com/project_details/project-gdg-website.html

## Problem

Participants need to understand an unusual hackathon format, find its schedule and reach the application form quickly.

## Contribution

Team contribution to the GDG on Campus IE University Tech Roulette event website, using semantic static pages, responsive layout and JavaScript navigation. Matteo also judged the final presentations.

## Technical approach and public case study

A clear route into a two-week hackathon: understand the wildcard format, find the next milestone, and apply.

- GDG on Campus IE University

- Team contribution

- HTML · CSS · JavaScript

### Make an unusual format easy to follow

Tech Roulette challenged teams to build an AI project around a randomly assigned theme. The April 13–27, 2026 event combined a kickoff, workshops, two build sprints and final presentations.

- Understand Explain the wildcard theme, team format and judging categories.

- Plan Show the dated roadmap from kickoff through the final event.

- Apply Send participants to the event’s application form.

### A focused static site

#### Readable event structure

Semantic page sections organize the schedule, rules and awards. The layout keeps event information available across screen sizes.

#### A direct application route

JavaScript synchronizes the application dock with page navigation. Registration is handled by the linked form, rather than a separate backend in this site.

### Part of the campus developer community

This was a contribution to the GDG team’s event website. I also served as a judge at the final presentations.

## Results and limitations

The site supported the April 13–27, 2026 event. Registration is handled by a linked application form; the website does not provide its own registration backend. No attendance or conversion metrics are claimed.
